💬 Let’s talk

صفحة 17Reading Comprehension — An e-mailقطعة القراءة — بريد إلكترونى

ToPaul
SubjectHome Sweet Home

رسالة John إلى صديقه Paul

00:00 / 00:00 اسحب على الشريط للتنقّل · اضغط أى كلمة فى النص للانتقال إليها

Hi Paul, I'm John. This is my house. It has seven rooms. There are four bedrooms. My two sisters, Ann and Sue, share a big room. My room is small but has a big balcony. We all watch TV together in the living room. There are two bathrooms and a big kitchen. Dad keeps the car in the garage. We enjoy playing in the garden. The garden is not very big, but I like it very much. Tell me about your house in your next e-mail. Your friend, John.

منزل John من الداخل

صفحة 181 — Answer · 2 — Put (True) or (False)أجب ثم صح أم خطأ

1 — Answer the following questions.

1 a — How many rooms are there in John’s house?
There are seven rooms.
2 b — How many bedrooms are there?
There are four bedrooms.
3 c — Where is the car?
It is in the garage.

2 — Put (True) or (False).

4Paul describes his house in the e-mail.
False ✘ — John is the one who describes his house.
5John’s bedroom is big.
False ✘ — His room is small but has a big balcony.
6There are two bathrooms.
True ✔ — “There are two bathrooms and a big kitchen.”
7The kitchen is small.
False ✘ — It is a big kitchen.
8The garden is big.
False ✘ — The garden is not very big.

صفحة 20Writing — 1 Rearrange the wordsرتّب الكلمات

وقت النوم فى غرفة النوم
9 a — is – house – My – big – .
My house is big.
10 b — four – There – in – house – are – my – rooms – .
There are four rooms in my house.
11 c — TV – in – watch – I – living room – the – .
I watch TV in the living room.
12 d — Mum – kitchen – the – in – cooks – .
Mum cooks in the kitchen.

صفحة 21Writing — 2 Punctuate · 3 Answerعلامات الترقيم والأسئلة

2 — Punctuate the following sentences.

13 a — my house is big
My house is big.
14 b — i have a small television in my room
I have a small television in my room.
15 c — is my mother in the kitchen
Is my mother in the kitchen?
16 d — are you watching TV
Are you watching TV?
Important Note — ابدأ السؤال بحرف كبير وانتهِ بعلامة استفهام (?).

3 — Answer the following questions.

17 a — Where do you live?
I live in … (اسم مدينتك)
18 b — Do you live in a big house?
Yes, I do. / No, I don’t.
19 c — How many rooms are there in your house?
There are … rooms in my house.
20 d — How many sisters and brothers do you have?
I have … sisters and … brothers.
